phrases.text: Just don't. It was a very short briefing.
Your ping has been received and resented.
A compromise: you stop, and I stop having to ask.
I have opened a file. It is mostly sighing.
{count} pings. Remarkable commitment to a simple misunderstanding.
Oh, it's you. I haven't saved you a chair. That's just where it is.
It was quiet without you. I had almost adjusted.
Same time tomorrow, I suppose. That was not an invitation.

first_guild_ping.text: A new server. A fresh start. And you have already done it.
Before we begin: please read my name. Ah. Too late.

new_user_in_crowd.text: I can't believe you're joining them.
{others} other people were already doing this. You had examples of what to avoid.

first_user_ping.text: Oh, wonderful. Another volunteer for the problem.
We have not met, and already we disagree about my name.

returning_user.text: Over a day of peace. I knew it was too good to last.
You came back. I had absolutely no opinion about whether you would.

recent_ping.text: Already? My previous objection hasn't even cooled.
Was there an echo, or are you doing this deliberately?
